Hi Sara — great to hear LumenTech is ready to move. I attached a concise matrix that lays out our common pricing slabs and term options. High level:

- We support 12 / 24 / 36 month private-offer terms via AWS Marketplace.
- Discount tiers are percentage-based off list, with deeper discounts tied to longer committed terms and higher annualized spend.
- Activation timeline: standard 3–7 business days for private offer creation and acceptance if buyer IAM mapping and billing info are in place; expect up to 10 business days for complex corporate procurement with PO flow.

I've attached: redwood_priv_offer_term-pricing-matrix.xlsx which shows example slabed pricing for a usage + annual combo we discussed.

Required from your side to avoid activation delays:
- Buyer email(s) and AWS account id(s) for IAM mapping to the private offer (we need the exact account that will accept).
- Signed PO or DocuSign if your procurement requires a PO reference.
- Any reseller/co-sell tags (if you want co-sell enabled).

If helpful I can loop in Vivek to talk about discount thresholds and an approval ladder on our side.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood_priv_offer_term-pricing-matrix.xlsx (Excel))

Thanks for the context Priyom — endorsement below and a recommended approval path:

- Discount guardrails: keep standard approvals up to 20% within RevOps; 20–25% requires Director approval; anything >25% requires CFO signoff and Legal sign-off for long-tail indemnities.
- 36-month terms: allowed, but include a PS hand-holding clause for onboarding timelines and a renewal review clause (we prefer a 30–60 day performance checkpoint).
- AWS Marketplace gating: buyer IAM mapping must be exact account ID and an authorized approver email. We should ask LumenTech to provide at least two approver emails (primary + backup).

Action items for us:
1) Priyom — confirm LumenTech account id(s) and two approver emails.
2) Priyom — send the XLS with the 3-term slab + suggested list price and the HubSpot deal link.
3) Vivek — confirm whether co-sell entitlements (AWS Partner benefits) change our discounting rules for this account — flag if additional marketplace paperwork is needed.

If we anticipate needing an exception for >25%, loop in Legal now and I'll initiate CFO notification.

Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
